d: The Credit Controller is responsible for managing receivables, minimizing credit risk, and supporting strong cash flow through effective credit assessment, collections, client engagement, and internal coordination. The role requires strong analytical, communication, and negotiation competencies aligned with business and financial objectives.
q: Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Mathematics, or related field
Relevant experience as a Credit Controller, preferably in an MNC
Proficiency in MS Office, Outlook, and financial systems
Proven ability to handle difficult clients professionally
r: Assess new credit requests and conduct customer credit checks
Evaluate customer financial risk and recommend credit limits
Monitor customer exposure and aging to prevent bad debt
Proactively follow up with clients for outstanding payments
Negotiate payment terms and settlement plans where required
Escalate delinquent accounts in line with company procedures
Conduct calls, meetings, and client visits to resolve overdue payments
Use company approved tools such as Get Paid and other collection systems
Ensure accurate system updates of receipts, follow ups, and disputes
Adhere to internal credit control policies and audit requirements
Competency: Attention to detail, data integrity
Maintain accurate customer master data and sales ledger
Prepare aging reports, account statements, and collection dashboards
Generate ad hoc reports as requested by management
Respond clearly and professionally to customer payment and invoice queries
Liaise with Sales and Operations teams to resolve billing discrepancies
Maintain professional relationships while enforcing credit control discipline
Identify early warning signs of nonpayment risk
Escalate concerns to management with mitigation recommendations
Support business units in achieving revenue realization
